title: Ban cap nhat v1.9.9 - Tich hop Scrcpy 1.24 MiChanger & Tu dong lam lai 2FA khi vang app
releaseNotes:
- Fix loi view man hinh: Thiet lap WS_CHILD va bo sung screenPanel.BringToFront de man hinh dien thoai khong bi che mat
- Tich hop bo Scrcpy 1.24 sieu nhe tu MiChanger (ket noi tuc thi trong 100ms, khong giat lag)
- Tu dong phat hien vang app hoac bi man hinh Chrome de len khi bat 2FA: tu dong dong trinh duyet, khoi dong lai Snapchat va bat 2FA lai tu dau
